revision_summary: One quote-check failure and a couple of schema-grounding gaps need targeted fixes before this ships: (1) Fix state_changes[2] timestamp \u2014 'Alright, mate.' is at 15:04, not 17:52 (which doesn't exist in this transcript; the call ends at 16:04). Additionally reconsider whether this two-word filler actually supports a 'resigned compliance' state_delta label, given the customer immediately continues talking substantively about his ice-covered panels afterward (15:17-15:41), which reads as continued engagement rather than resignation. (2) Strengthen the 15:17 ice/snow moment: it should be cross-referenced against orphaned_flow's explicit qualifying question 'Is your system working?' (hard_dq_answers: not_working/broken) in addition to cross_sell_signals \u2014 the customer's answer ('completely covered with snow... turned into a big sheet of ice... been that way for weeks') is a direct hit on a schema-defined DQ trigger, not just a generic cross-sell opportunity, and a manager should see that framing. (3) Remove or relabel the fabricated 'military' entry in script_coverage \u2014 there is no such schema section; if the veteran disclosure at 13:52 is worth tracking, file it under vulnerability_disclosure_handling (which Stage 3 already correctly does elsewhere) rather than inventing a new script_coverage category. (4) Consider adding a brief tech_friction_handling note for the ~3-4 minute bill-photo-texting struggle (08:14-11:58) against the elderly_low_tech_protocol schema section, since the customer's age and difficulty are established and this friction window is close to the schema's stated time budget concern, even if it doesn't clearly breach the 2-minute pivot threshold. These are targeted fixes, not a full rerun \u2014 the core trajectory read (orphaned lead correctly redirected to battery cross-sell, vulnerability disclosure under-acknowledged, fragile tentative booking) is well-grounded and should be preserved.
